text:
maya: hey team - new hire here, day 1. i'm on Ubuntu laptop using our split-tunnel VPN. i can ssh to bastion but apt, pip, and docker pulls to our internal registry 10.9.1.20 keep failing. DNS for registry.int.redwood doesn't resolve on my machine. any low-friction fixes?

derek: welcome @maya! quick checklist: 1) does `dig +short registry.int.redwood` return anything locally or on bastion? 2) which VPN client? 3) are you using systemd-resolved?

maya: dig returns nothing locally; on bastion it returns 10.9.1.20. using our corporate wg profile. systemd-resolved running.

carla: sounds like split-DNS not configured for your profile. short-term options depending on tool: - apt respects Acquire::http::Proxy in /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/ - pip and docker can use env vars HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY or use localhost tunnels.

maya: apt fails during `apt-get update` with timeout. pip errors out when pulling wheels from our private index. docker can't pull base images from registry.int.redwood:5000.

derek: fastest for multiple clients: create a local SOCKS proxy via the bastion: `ssh -D 1080 ubuntu@bastion.redwood -N`. then configure tools to use it. For CLI tools you can use `proxychains` or `tsocks` or set env vars. Example: `ALL_PROXY=socks5h://localhost:1080 pip install -i http://registry.int.redwood/simple package` (socks5h forces remote DNS).

carla: for apt you need an HTTP proxy. you can run `socat` on the bastion to forward, but easier is an SSH HTTP tunnel locally using `ssh -L 3128:127.0.0.1:3128 ubuntu@bastion.redwood` if there's a proxy on the bastion, or use `ssh -D` with a local HTTP proxy like `proxychains` + `polipo` or `privoxy`. busy but doable.

maya: ugh that's a lot. is there an even simpler "one-liner" to make apt and pip work?

derek: one-liner using `ssh -fN -D 1080 ubuntu@bastion.redwood` then install `proxychains-ng` and update /etc/proxychains.conf: `socks5 127.0.0.1 1080`. then run `proxychains4 apt-get update` and `proxychains4 pip install ...`. For pip, `ALL_PROXY` is simpler: `ALL_PROXY=socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080 pip install ...`

maya: tried ssh -D and proxychains for apt, it worked for apt-get update! pip with ALL_PROXY works too. docker still fails (it doesn't honor proxy env on desktop).

carla: Docker Desktop on Linux generally uses system proxy settings in daemon. two options: 1) configure Docker daemon to use an HTTP proxy (add /etc/systemd/system/docker.service.d/http-proxy.conf with env vars and restart), or 2) run `docker build` with buildkit and an HTTP proxy build-arg. Another hack: run `docker pull` on the bastion and `docker save | docker load` locally, but that's clunky.

maya: i won't be doing heavy docker pulls today so i'll stick to proxychains/ALL_PROXY. any chance we can get the split-DNS fixed for new hires so this isn't manual?

derek: i'll open a ticket with netops to push internal resolver and add common internal hostnames to the WireGuard profile. ops-bot, please create ticket.

ops-bot: created ticket #9124: "WireGuard split-DNS: add registry.int.redwood + resolver push for new hire profiles" assigned to @carla.

carla: i'll triage #9124 tomorrow. long-term we'll push the internal resolver IP and DNS suffix so DNS resolution works automatically. also we'll add the quick SSH tunnel notes to the onboarding doc (proxychains, ALL_PROXY examples).

it-bot: onboarding checklist updated: add SSH SOCKS and proxychains examples for apt/pip/docker edge cases.

maya: thanks all, the proxychains trick saved my setup. i'll add a note in my onboarding repo and let you know if anything else pops up :heart:
